summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of Clara Radio Editor Dashboard new features. All 22 tests passed (100%). Features tested: 4-hour session timeout with expires_at in login response, config endpoint returning share_base_url as clara.koodh.com, media folder CRUD operations, folder sharing with users/shows/series, show/rundown delete permissions (admin only), and bulk assignment changes for recurring shows.
critical_code_review_comments: Session timeout correctly implemented with JWT_EXPIRATION_HOURS=4 in database.py
Login endpoint returns expires_at timestamp (~4 hours from login time)
Config endpoint correctly returns share_base_url as 'https://clara.koodh.com'
Media folders support nested structure with parent_id
Folder sharing supports users, shows, and series via FolderShareRequest model
Delete folder correctly moves assets to root when move_to_root=True
Show delete requires admin role (require_admin dependency)
Rundown item delete requires admin role (require_admin dependency)
Bulk assignment supports three apply_to options: this_only, all_future, all
Frontend SessionWarningModal properly integrated with 5-minute warning before logout
seed_data_creation: Created test presenter user via /api/users/invite endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new backend features tested and working. Key endpoints: GET /api/config (returns share_base_url), POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/media/folders (folder CRUD), POST /api/media/folders/{id}/shares (folder sharing), POST /api/series/{id}/assignments/bulk (bulk assignment), DELETE /api/occurrences/{id}/rundown/{item_id} (admin only). Session timeout is 4 hours with 5-minute warning modal.

session_timeout.details: Login returns expires_at timestamp approximately 4 hours from login time

folder_create.details: POST /api/media/folders creates folder with name, color, parent_id

folder_nested.details: Folders can be nested using parent_id

folder_delete.details: DELETE /api/media/folders/{id} deletes folder and moves assets to root

folder_share_user.details: POST /api/media/folders/{id}/shares with user_ids shares folder with users

folder_share_show.details: POST /api/media/folders/{id}/shares with show_ids links folder to shows

folder_share_series.details: POST /api/media/folders/{id}/shares with series_ids links folder to series

folder_get_shares.details: GET /api/media/folders/{id}/shares returns all shares for folder

rundown_delete_permission.details: Non-admin (presenter) cannot delete rundown item - returns 403

bulk_assign_this_only.details: apply_to='this_only' only creates series assignment, no occurrence updates

bulk_assign_all_future.details: apply_to='all_future' creates series assignment + future occurrence assignments

bulk_assign_all.details: apply_to='all' creates series assignment + all occurrence assignments

mocked_integrations.none: All features are fully implemented with real database operations
